title: Golden Adventure Capability & Playability Proof
objective: Close the MAS program with deterministic Golden Adventure capability and playability proof over MAS-01..20 while preserving all canonical owner/runtime/resource/publication authorities and proving the prepared Adventure Studio capability without treating proof fixtures or projections as live-state mutation or publication.
